'''Sumok''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] who served aboard the [[Ill Wind (smuggler ship)|''Ill Wind'']]. Sumok had ties to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He trained the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Monnda Tebbo]] and told the young navigator to contact the Alliance if he was ever in trouble. Sumok died in a skirmish with [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] above [[Uogo'cor/Legends|Uogo'cor]].
